2610.04706.title: VoCa: Designing Speech-Canvas Interaction for Voice-Based Conversational Agents
2610.04706.paper_summary: People write and sketch while speaking to explain, organize, and develop content together. Inspired by these practices, we investigate how voice agents can use a canvas alongside speech in multi-turn conversations with users. We conducted a two-part formative study: an observational study of how pairs coordinated speech and boardwork, followed by a design workshop that informed a design space for speech-canvas interaction with voice agents. Building on these insights, we developed VoCa, a voice agent that coordinates speech with visual object creation, annotation, and attention guidance. A five-day deployment with 18 participants examined usability, experiences of speech-canvas interaction, patterns of use, and desired improvements. Participants' experiences highlighted opportunities for speech-canvas interaction in learning, work, and daily life, alongside challenges in coordinating what agents say and show in ways users can follow and influence. These findings inform how voice agents can use a canvas alongside speech in conversation.
2610.04706.paper_summary_zh: 人們在說話時寫作和素描，以解釋、組織和共同發展內容。受到這些實踐的啟發，我們研究了語音代理如何在與用戶的多輪對話中，將畫布與語音結合使用。我們進行了一項兩部分的形成性研究：首先是觀察研究，了解配對如何協調語音和板面工作，然後是設計工作坊，為語音-畫布互動的設計空間提供了信息。在這些見解的基礎上，我們開發了VoCa，一個將語音與視覺物體創建、註釋和注意力引導協調的語音代理。為期五天的部署與18名參與者一起檢查了可用性、語音-畫布互動的體驗、使用模式和期望的改進。參與者的體驗突顯了在學習、工作和日常生活中進行語音-畫布互動的機會，以及在協調代理所說和所示的內容，使得用戶能夠跟隨和影響的挑戰。這些發現為語音代理如何在對話中將畫布與語音結合使用提供了信息。
